name: Boeing B-17G Flying Fortress
blurb: The game's original Blender B-17G, measured from a three-view with moving gear, four propellers, controls, six defensive gun groups and bomb-bay doors.
history:
The Boeing B-17 Flying Fortress was the United States Army Air Forces' best-known four-engine heavy bomber in Europe. The late B-17G added the Bendix chin turret to an already formidable defensive armament.

What this entry models: an original Blender B-17G (span 103 ft 9 in, length 74 ft 4 in, thirteen .50-caliber guns) measured against Kaboldy's corrected Wikimedia Commons three-view. It is the model used in flight; the retired download remains in the DEV Hangar.
